players.product: High-capacitance (1uF-100uF) X5R/X6S BME MLCCs (GRM/GCM series) for PDN decoupling

quarterly_data.signal: Murata Manufacturing Vietnam, a manufacturing subsidiary, completed a new production building for coil products at its Ho Chi Minh branch (Dong Nai City, Vietnam), with a completion ceremony on October 8, 2026; construction began in May 2025 and the investment is approximately 3 billion yen (building only). The three-story building has a total floor area of 10,576 m2; a production system will be put in place and operations will begin sequentially, and Murata says it will work toward stable supply of coil products for consumer equipment and automotive use.
quarterly_data.figure: approx. 3 billion yen (building only); 10,576 m2 total floor area; completed October 2026
